What do you do?

Heal 24 HP. Fight some enemies.

Dense Vegetation
You hack and slash your way through the jungle but it goes on and on...

You sustain yourself on strange fruits, crunchy bugs, and drink the nectar of glowing plants but you start feeling paranoid...

But then you find a clearing, a trail, and some Gold coins scattered on the ground. Amongst the coins are some crudely-drawn maps!
Problem solved.
Proceed
